context: Compose song lyrics about a socio-economic problem. The song should be in English and in all lowercase letters.

trace.content:
the screen is bright but the room is cold
another bill has been left unpaid
they say the market is always growing
but i'm shrinking in the shade

the rent goes up while the wages stay the same
a tiny margin for a bigger name
we trade our hours for a plastic card
hoping the numbers will ever expand

the elevator breaks on the forty-second floor
the lobby lights flicker and then disappear
they talk about opportunity and the dream
while the lock on the door is made of steel

i see the kids with the heavy bags
carrying futures that feel too fragile
they walk past the glass where the rich look down
and wonder why the sky feels so fragile

it's not a lack of work or a lack of will
it's the math that doesn't add up right
a system built on a narrow bridge
leading nowhere but into the night

so i sing this song with a quiet voice
for the ones who are tired of the race
maybe one day the walls will come down
and we can finally find our place
